calibration_profile: Sir Simon Rattle / Berliner Philharmoniker (Philharmonie Berlin)

1.event: Lower string furious sixteenth-note recitative attack
Oboe and English horn lament over marching bass ostinato
First lyrical E major vision in muted strings
Sudden return of C minor funeral march
Subterranean development opening in pizzicato basses
English horn pastoral mirage in C major
First entry of Dies Irae chorale fragment in horns
Cataclysmic E-flat minor orchestral storm peak
Recapitulation: shattering return of Totenfeier recitative
Coda funeral procession sinking into the abyss
Final descending chromatic scale and dry pizzicato stroke

2.event: Graceful A-flat major Ländler in muted first violins
Return of Ländler dressed in delicate cello pizzicato
Second dark triplet storm with brass cries
Final return of Ländler with harp and woodwind filigree

3.event: Three dry timpani solo blows launching the 3/8 Scherzo
Wry E-flat clarinet parody with rute and pizzicato
First Trio: blazing D major brass fanfare
Return of perpetual-motion C minor whirlpool
Second Trio and rising orchestral vortex
The Aufschrei (Totengreif): shattering B-flat minor scream of despair

4.event: Contralto solo unaccompanied entry: 'O Röschen rot!'
Solemn D-flat major brass chorale halo
B-flat minor lament: 'Der Mensch liegt in größter Not!'
Clarinet, harp, and solo violin celestial consolation
Ardent declaration of faith: 'Ich bin von Gott und will wieder zu Gott!'

5.event: Wild herausfahrend: return of the Scherzo scream of despair
Distant offstage horn call ('The Crier in the Wilderness')
Solemn Dies Irae chorale in woodwinds and pizzicato strings
Contralto Resurrection motif foreshadowed in winds
Grand Dead March (Allegro energico) in trombones and tutti
Spatial collision of onstage storm and offstage military brass band
Passionate F-sharp minor anguish cry ('O glaube')
Der große Appell: Four offstage trumpets, horns, flute & piccolo birdcall
Chorus a cappella entry: 'Aufersteh'n, ja aufersteh'n wirst du'
Soprano solo floating emerges seamless from the choral mist
Contralto solo pleading ('O glaube, mein Herz, o glaube')
Duet of Soprano and Contralto ('O Schmerz! Du Alldurchdringer!')
Full Chorus & Orchestra eruption: 'Mit Flügeln, die ich mir errungen'
Full Pipe Organ (Pleno) and Three Deep Bells enter: 'Sterben werd' ich, um zu leben!'
